## Checklist

- [ ] I described the change in words. I did not attach the book PDF or page scans.
- [ ] If the JSON or CSVs changed, I ran `python scripts/generate_derived.py`.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_data.py` passes.
- [ ] Column names are unchanged, or the data dictionary, `llms.txt`, and the validator were updated together.
- [ ] I opened `viewer/index.html` locally if the viewer changed.
